name: Data Broker Opt-Out Bot
tagline: Chases down the deletion requests that pull you off contact-data broker lists
description: Helps you find where your personal contact details are being resold and files the opt-out or deletion requests broker by broker. It keeps a checklist of where you have already written in, what still needs a follow-up, and when to check that the listing has actually come down.
author: JackyHeshi
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
